concerns.text: FR-002 (administer SART and Ospan via a web interface) is not covered by any task. The task list jumps from ID generation to OSF instrument verification without a concrete data‑collection implementation, weakening the functional requirement.
FR-003 (administer PSS‑10 and PANAS questionnaires) is absent from the task list, leaving the study without a mechanism to capture the self‑report measures required by the spec.

FR-006 specifies that a Wilcoxon fallback must be triggered when the Shapiro‑Wilk test yields p < 0.05. Task T013 instead triggers the fallback only on a `bootstrap_status.json` flag `convergence_failed`, contradicting the spec and weakening the statistical methodology.

FR-009 (pre‑study pilot check of SART/Ospan response‑time ranges and scoring logic) is not represented by any task, so the required validation of instrument functionality before recruitment is omitted.

Success criteria SC‑001 – SC‑005 require that statistical significance (p < 0.05) and effect‑size thresholds (Cohen’s d ≥ 0.2) be met. No task includes a verification step that asserts these thresholds are satisfied; T014 only validates schema compliance.
